name: Hard Times at Sequoia State Park
source:
Sequoia State tells the story of Chole, a college burnout who has a big and throbbing secret...
...in her pants!

Watch the story erect itself as Chloe deals with a couple of intrusive sorority skanks who have some burning questions and cruel intentions!

You decide whether Chloe gives in to the temptations of the buxom brats, or teach them a lesson they'll never forget!
